summary: No edits needed. The page's current-main guidance matches the reviewed source: compact_runtime.py handles dependency waiting and bootstrap-link logging; bootstrap_self_mint.py defines the 15-minute link and issuance conditions; connection_strings.py and rabbitmq_transport.py define connection resolution and verified TLS; compact_container_cli.py and the users command specs support the documented container CLI guidance; health.py and volume.py support readiness and one-runtime-per-volume behavior. The 2026-09-28 acceptance details remain explicitly historical. Current Render Blueprint settings, image availability, pricing, and dashboard behavior are external and unverified; the page tells readers to confirm them. The source review supports behavior on main and does not establish a published release.
